description: Source code for WebSocket extension parser implementation, including parsing logic for WebSocket extension headers and parameters.

classes.name: WebSocketExtensionParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing WebSocket extension headers and parameters.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses WebSocket extension data from a character buffer.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes a specific character if present.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Consumes a WebSocket extension token and its parameters.

methods.name: ConsumeExtensionParameter
methods.description: Consumes a parameter within a WebSocket extension.

methods.name: ConsumeToken
methods.description: Consumes a token from the input stream.

methods.name: Lookahead
methods.description: Checks if the next character matches without advancing the parser.

methods.name: ConsumeIfMatch
methods.description: Consumes a character if it matches the current input.
